final_trustworthiness_assessment: High for primary sources. westnile.ca.gov is the official CDPH WNV surveillance portal (ca.gov domain, CDPH Vector-Borne Disease Section authorship). CDC historic data page is a federal .gov source using ArboNET surveillance data. publichealth.lacounty.gov is the official LA County Department of Public Health domain. These three source types meet the highest trust threshold for public health surveillance data. News sources (latimes.com, abcnews.com) are credible regional/national outlets but are secondary to official agency sources. Out-of-scope, social media, and non-authoritative sources (illinois DPH, facebook, instagram, cola.org, vdci.net) should be excluded or treated as low-trust.
